To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the knowledge of the students regarding SRH was not satisfactory.

there were gaps among the students in the knowledge, attitude and practice towards SRH including CSE and need to remedy them by giving appropriate SRH and CSE classes to the first year university students.
there is a need for more comprehensive sexual and reproductive health education in Malaysia.
In summary, our research is concerned with
students' knowledge, attitude, and behavior in sexual education and comprehensive sexuality education.
the knowledge, attitude and practice of students in the field of sexual health, including comprehensive sexual education (CSE).
the knowledge, attitude and practice of sexual and reproductive health among first year students of University Malaysia Sabaha.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the students' awareness of sexual education was limited, knowledge of HIV/AIDS, condoms and abortion services was more in Science students, attitude towards sexuality education was favourable in both groups and behaviour of watching and listening to pornographic materials was more among Arts students.
the knowledge, attitude and practice in sexual and reproductive healthcare including comprehensive sexuality education among the first year students in UMS is inadequate.

there are gaps in knowledge, attitudes and behaviour of SRHealth and need to remedy them by giving appropriate CCE classes to first year students in an elective subject according to their culture, religion and belief.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown the need of CSE in Malaysia.
there are gaps in knowledge, attitudes and behaviour of SR H among first year UMS students.
there is a gap in knowledge, attitude, and practice of sexual and reproductive health among first year university students.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the knowledge, attitudes and practices of first year UMS students towards sexual and reproductive health are not optimal and need improvement.
the students' knowledge, attitude and practice in SRH including CSE is still low.
there is an urgent need to improve the sexual health knowledge, attitudes and practices of university students in Malaysia.
